---
title: "Community"
---

2 requirement(s) in this category.

### COM-001 — Discuss on Zulip before and during contribution {#sec-com-001}

**Mathlib + PhysLean** · Level **SHOULD**

Contributors SHOULD join the project's Zulip, introduce themselves, add their GitHub username to their Zulip profile, and discuss a contribution before and during development. Mathlib uses the `#mathlib4` channel; PhysLean uses the `#physlib` channel.

**Acceptance criteria**

- The contributor has raised the work on the relevant Zulip channel.
- Their Zulip profile lists their GitHub username.

**Rationale.** Early discussion catches scope, duplication, and design issues before review, and connects the contributor to a reviewer.

**Source.** <https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/how-to-contribute.html>

---

### COM-002 — Non-code ways to contribute (PhysLean) {#sec-com-002}

**PhysLean** · Level **MAY**

Beyond formalisation, contributors MAY help by promoting the project, clearing TODO-list items, answering Zulip questions, resolving GitHub issues, code-golfing and documenting existing code, contributing informal results, joining open GitHub projects, or picking up mini-projects.

**Acceptance criteria**

- Non-code contributions are directed through the listed channels (TODO list, Zulip, issues, projects).

**Rationale.** A broad menu of contribution modes welcomes people of all backgrounds and keeps the project healthy beyond raw formalisation.

**Source.** <http://physlib.io/get-involved>
